title: Messaging, Streams, and Workflows
focus: Separate authoritative facts, commands, events, queues, logs, streams, and derived state, with explicit owners and rebuild contracts.

pacing.review: Skim lessons, answer self-checks, and take one generated quiz.
pacing.standard: Study lessons, complete guided practice, use the answer key, and take one or more generated quizzes.
pacing.deep: Complete standard work plus the reinforcement lab and optional project.

lessons.title: Authority, Events, Queues, Logs, and Streams
Delivery Semantics, Identities, and Exactly-Once Boundaries
Ordering, Partition Keys, and Consumer Groups
Transactional Outbox, Inbox, and Change Data Capture
Event Time, Watermarks, Lag, and Bounded Recovery

learning_outcomes.statement: Separate authoritative facts, commands, events, queues, logs, streams, and derived state, with explicit owners and rebuild contracts.
Derive delivery failure windows, stable identities, ordering scope, and defensible exactly-once boundaries.
Select partition keys and consumer-group topology from workload, fairness, and per-aggregate invariants.
Implement an atomic outbox, stable envelope, publisher, idempotent inbox, derived view, and CDC checkpoint boundary.
Design safe replay, poison handling, schema evolution, derived-state rebuild, and reconciliation.
Model durable workflows, orchestration or choreography, idempotent compensation, and explicit points of no return.
Calculate lag and drain time and apply explicit event-time, watermark, late-data, backpressure, and recovery policies.
Diagnose nine asynchronous failures and defend an RFC covering semantics, operations, security, cost, migration, ownership, dissent, and reversal evidence.

lab.note: Use the lab to reinforce the local mechanism; treat expanded matrices and platform-specific evidence as optional deep-dive work.

optional_project.description: Apply Messaging, Streams, and Workflows to a small system you know. Write a short design note, experiment report, or implementation summary only if you want deeper practice.
